game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before mischievous imps can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before mischievous imps can use it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the signal beacon using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the signal beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Throne Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Throne Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
